rulingTitle: After enqueue → runner rejection → API-refused resend, sent remains true while supersededDelivery hides the rejection, so the card incorrectly shows queued and disables Approve/Deny despite no command being enqueued.

action.reason: Verified defect: a refused resend leaves sent=true and suppresses the previous rejection, falsely showing queued and disabling Approve/Deny. Human review is required before readiness.

rationale: send() only changes sent on success and supersedes delivery before knowing the outcome. Clear stale sent state and preserve the prior rejection when a resend fails. Add a regression covering enqueue → runner rejection → API-refused resend; the existing refusal test covers only an initially failed send.
